publications.description: Be Bugging/Mutation Testing is a way of determining the effectiveness of testing. That is, it is a technique that may be used to determine the number of remaining bugs in a software artifact after testing/review. Mutation Testing is a fault-based testing technique which provides a testing criterion called the“mutation adequacy score”. The mutation adequacy score can be used to measure theeffectiveness of a test set in terms of its ability to detect faults.
publications.subtitle: International Journal of Modern Engineering and Research Technology
publications.title: Be bugging: An Approach for Mutation Testing

positions.description_html:
As a Graduate Research Assistant (GRA) with a focus on large language models and advanced machine learning, my role involves a multifaceted approach to research, experimentation, and academic review. My responsibilities are divided into three primary areas:

1. Research Tasks:
Literature Review: Conduct thorough literature reviews to identify emerging trends, methodologies, and advancements in the field of large language models and deep learning. This involves synthesizing current research to inform and guide ongoing projects.
Project Implementation: Lead the design and implementation of innovative projects involving large language models(LLMs).This includes developing and fine-tuning models using Python and other relevant tools to address complex problems and advance state-of-the-art technologies.
2. Hands-on Experiment Design:
Design and execute a series of 12 distinct hands-on experiments aimed at exploring various aspects of large language models and deep learning techniques. This involves creating experimental setups, analyzing results, and iterating on designs to test hypotheses and validate findings.
3. Paper Reviews:
Journal Review: Evaluate and provide constructive feedback on academic journal submissions related to machine learning and large language models. This involves assessing the novelty, significance, and technical rigor of the research.
Conference Review: Review and critique papers submitted to industry conferences, ensuring high standards of quality and relevance in the presentations and discussions.
In this role, I leverage my expertise in machine learning, deep learning, and Python programming to drive forward research initiatives and contribute to the academic community. My work is dedicated to pushing the boundaries of knowledge in large language models and their applications.

projects.description: ARCH aims to provide an internship search program that searches for potential AND achievements. There were two main problems with other, similar programs.Sites such as LinkedIn or Glassdoor mainly focus on connecting people for jobs as opposed to internships. This means that young adults or students looking to ease into an industry will have a much harder time finding a program that fits them because their search is watered down by the sheer amount of businesses fighting for job recruits.The few internship search websites that exist strongly prioritize experience in their algorithm. New students hoping to get into an industry have an uphill battle fighting for a spot in an internship program. ARCH solves this. Our search algorithm incorporates an intern’s skills, past projects, achievements, and age into the equation. We call it the “bone meal algorithm,” and it is the solution that sets us apart from the competition.
projects.title: ARCH

projects.description: Big Ben was made to prepare future generations for the tough financial environment America has. Currently, 32% of Americans are registered as bankrupt and only 5% of American are millionaires! In other words, only 5% of Americans have achieved financial peace. Habits such as spending and debt put most Americans into bankruptcy and massive amounts of debt that takes years to pay off. We're lucky enough to be taught at a young age how to take advantage of our money and not let it control our future, so it was a shock to see that this knowledge was so limited throughout our peers. The purpose of Big Ben is to help our future generation develop good financial habits early on so that they know how to avoid developing bad habits later.
projects.title: Big Ben

projects.description: Daybreak is an intelligent and affordable wearable device that monitors and protects dementia patients through its GPS tracker and heart-rate monitor.According to the Alzheimer’s Association, 1 in 3 seniors die with Alzheimer's or another dementia, meaning it kills more than breast cancer and prostate cancer combined. This is a serious issue. The technology and infrastructure simply does not exist for loved ones to care for the vulnerable and affected. Something needs to change. Enter Daybreak, the intelligent, convenient, and affordable wearable GPS that detects seizures. Ease of mind and care should not be a luxury nor a hassle: Daybreak brings innovative safety technology into the hands of everyone. Daybreak is relief for the 55 million people in the world who suffer from dementia. It's a chance for the 66% of dementia patients who come from lower middle-income countries and might not be able to afford more expensive alternatives. Daybreak is the future of care technology.Daybreak technology is sleek, modern, and straightforward. As a noninvasive wearable, we ensure that it will be as compact as possible. Instead of using a SIM card to connect to the internet, the simpler option, we devised a method to discard the bulkiness for convenience. The wearable bounces data to nearby phones through our app, which allows it to be 4 times smaller than our original design with a SIM card. Without the additional cost, it is also more low-priced to manufacture which allows us to stay economically competitive. Daybreak is built on the ESP32 platform which makes it very power efficient. Instead of using traditional Bluetooth 5.3, we use Bluetooth LE which can run on as little as 1% of the power that Bluetooth 5.3 requires while maintaining full 2 megabits per second speeds. The entire board, the Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32C3, runs on only 3.3 volts at 200 milliamps which enables us to push the battery life of the board to years. That's years of convenience.
projects.title: Daybreak

projects.description: REMEDY is an AI trained with over 27,000 photos of various skin conditions, from eczema to melanoma cancer. Our original idea was to track the progression of various skin diseases and automatically return the improvements or worsening of the disease so that users can gauge their progress. However, with a lack of data on the progression of skin diseases, definitely not enough to create an accurate AI, we have settled on creating a slightly simpler program. It analyzes a picture the user submits in the app of a possible disease site, and will be returned with the expected condition and percentage that the AI’s analysis was correct. The page also allows the user to create a link to their results, so they are able to send it to their dermatologist or family members. These programs work in accordance with one another to allow the user to get the best on-demand checkup, right from their pocket. There are additional pages in REMEDY mainly to create the best user experience. projects.description: White Sky gamifies the process of creating a schedule and weekly goals. There are levels, XP, SkyCoins customizable avatars. a shop, and achievements. Users have to create their schedule for the day before being able to check up on their dinosaur avatar. This pushes them to prioritize their time and academics before being allowed to play with their dinosaur. The more that a student sticks to their schedule and completes their activities, the higher XP that they will receive. XP is mainly used to level up, but also gives more SkyCoins to the user. These in-game tokens allow them to buy items from the shop. Shop items can be added onto their dinosaur, so that it appears to be wearing a shirt or a pair of shoes. Finally, the achievements entice the user to keep coming back and using the website, which then builds that habit of daily planning. Overall, the program teaches young kids how to organize and effectively complete their work in a way that feels more like a game than a lecture.

bright_candidates.about: Over 9 plus years of experiance as a Senior .NET Full Stack Developer, I specialize in designing, developing, and maintaining web applications using a broad range of technologies. My expertise spans both front-end and back-end development, ensuring seamless integration between user interfaces and server-side functionalities. On the back end, I am proficient in ASP.NET Core, C#, and .NET Core, with a focus on building secure RESTful APIs using OAuth2 and JWT authentication. I have extensive experience with Entity Framework Core, ADO.NET, and both SQL and NoSQL databases such as SQL Server and MongoDB, ensuring efficient data management. My work in Microservices Architecture enables the creation of scalable and maintainable systems. On the front end, I excel in Angular, React, HTML5, CSS3, TypeScript, and Bootstrap, developing responsive and high-performance Single Page Applications (SPAs). My deep understanding of Angular and React’s component-based architecture allows me to create modular, reusable UI components, enhancing maintainability. My skills in HTML5 and CSS3, including advanced techniques like Flexbox and Grid, enable the development of effective, responsive designs. By leveraging TypeScript for static typing and RxJS for managing asynchronous data streams, I ensure efficient handling of real-time updates and API integrations for dynamic data display. I have extensive experience with cloud technologies, particularly Azure, where I work with Azure Functions, Blob Storage, Service Bus, and API Gateway to deploy cloud-native applications. Additionally, I optimize CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps to automate testing, building, and deployment processes. My AWS expertise includes implementing cloud-native solutions with services like S3, EC2, RDS, and DynamoDB, along with scalable messaging systems using SNS and SQS. I have a strong grasp of Agile methodologies, including Scrum and Kanban, with experience in managing sprints and backlog refinement. As a mentor and team leader, I drive successful project execution and foster team development. My proficiency in testing frameworks such as Karma, Jasmine, Protractor (front-end), xUnit.NET (back-end), API testing tools like Postman and Swagger, and version control with Git, combined with expertise in task management tools like JIRA, Rally, and TFS, positions me as a versatile and highly capable Senior Full Stack Developer.

experience.description: As a Senior Full Stack Developer, I led the design and development of cloud-native logistics platforms that improved real-time shipment tracking, warehouse automation, and nationwide supply chain visibility. I built and optimized microservices architecture using Java 17, Spring Boot, JPA, and Hibernate, integrating Kafka and RabbitMQ for event-driven updates on freight, fleet, and inventory.On the frontend, I created high-performance SPAs with React.js, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, and Material-UI, enabling logistics teams and customers to monitor shipments and manage orders in real time. I developed and standardized RESTful & SOAP APIs for interoperability with carriers, warehouses, and customs systems, while improving API performance with Redis caching, async processing, and API Gateway optimization.I deployed solutions on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) with Helm, Terraform, and Azure DevOps pipelines, ensuring fault-tolerant, scalable systems. By implementing CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and SonarQube, I enabled automated, zero-downtime releases using blue-green and canary strategies. I also built real-time data pipelines with Apache Spark, Kafka Streams, and AWS Glue, delivering predictive analytics on fleet utilization and delivery forecasting.To ensure security and compliance, I implemented OAuth2, JWT, RBAC, SAML, and Swagger-based API documentation, aligning with enterprise and healthcare standards. I further strengthened operations by configuring Dynatrace, Prometheus, Azure Monitor, and Application Insights for proactive monitoring and anomaly detection.Collaborating in Agile teams, I aligned development with business needs, mentored junior developers, and established best practices. The result was a scalable, secure, and future-ready logistics platform that boosted supply chain efficiency, reduced downtime, and improved customer satisfaction.

experience.description: At VUST, I designed and delivered cloud-native academic platforms that streamlined student, faculty, and administrative experiences. I developed student information systems and faculty portals using React.js, Node.js, and Spring Boot, improving accessibility and modernizing university workflows. By building Single Page Applications (SPAs) with React, Redux, and TypeScript, I enabled students to self-manage tasks such as course registration, exam scheduling, and grade tracking — reducing administrative workload by 35%.To ensure seamless operations, I built RESTful APIs and GraphQL endpoints for secure data exchange between admissions, finance, and academic systems, while implementing a microservices architecture on AWS (Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, MongoDB, Kubernetes) for scalability and resilience. I also created an automated document management system that reduced transcript and faculty record retrieval times by 40%, enhancing academic data availability.Security and compliance were critical. I integrated OAuth2, JWT, AWS Cognito, and RBAC for secure authentication and access control, while ensuring compliance with WCAG 2.1 accessibility standards, delivering inclusive applications for all users. I optimized search using Elasticsearch, supported student performance analytics with real-time data from MongoDB and Cassandra, and built an event-driven notification system using Kafka and Spring JMS to provide instant alerts on deadlines, assignments, and schedules.To further streamline workflows, I integrated Google Classroom APIs with AWS Lambda for automated grading and submissions, reducing faculty workload. I also created interactive dashboards with React, Redux, and Chart.js for administrators, enabling data-driven decisions on academic performance, enrollment, and faculty utilization. Finally, I implemented CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins, Kubernetes, and AWS Code Pipeline, ensuring efficient deployments with minimal downtime.
